display_long_description:
**Can you cook when nothing is given to you?**

**Isle of Food** is an open-world cozy VR cooking game where cooking begins outside the kitchen. There are no ready-made ingredients or shortcuts. To cook, you must explore the island to hunt, fish, gather, and farm everything yourself.

Only what you bring back can be cooked. Each dish is prepared by hand using natural VR interactions, and your progress depends on how well you manage your stylish island restaurant.

The world shapes your menu, and your choices shape the experience.

[media]

# Core mechanics: 
✔ VR cooking with natural hand interactions 

✔ 100+ real and fantasy recipes 

✔ Multiple cooking methods: baking, boiling, frying, grilling 

✔ Open-world island exploration

✔ Hunting, Fishing, Gathering, Farming 

✔ Day–night cycle and dynamic weather  

✔ Restaurant management, upgrades, decorations and progression 

[media]

# Main Features  
**Experience simulation-level cooking.** You slice, fry, boil, bake and craft meals from 100+ recipes ranging from real-world classics to fantasy dishes.

**Every recipe starts with exploration** — hunt wildlife, track birds, fish along the coast, gather fruits and herbs, or grow your own crops near the restaurant.  

[media]

# A New Cooking Experience  
**Guests set the pace of your restaurant management experience.** Each day brings visitors with different tastes.  

**From your first simple meals to a fully developed 7-star restaurant**, Isle of Food builds a complete VR cooking adventure.  

[media]

Coming 2026 — **ADD TO WISHLIST** and don’t miss the launch.
